name: Eagles Day Camp
description_short: Eastern Christian School day camp for children entering PK4 or TK and grades K to 2, with a weekly theme such as arts and crafts, cooking, music, nature or junior sports. Activities include tie dye, outdoor games and water play.
refund_policy_summary: A nonrefundable 40% deposit per camper per week holds the spot. Written cancellations before June 1 may get a partial refund; none after June 1 except case by case for medical or family emergencies. Partial weeks are not prorated.
notes: Full day $400 a week (drop off 8 to 9 am, pick up 2:45 to 3 pm); half day preschool $200 a week (pick up 11:45 to noon); aftercare 3 to 6 pm $150 a week. The 2027 page still says ages are for fall 2026. The 40% deposit counts toward tuition. Lunch is packed from home or ordered from the school's Eagle Cafe.
